The '''Battle in the Factory District ''' occurred during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During their search for [[10-4TO]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his companions fought against [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Factory District]], inhabited by hostile [[feral droid]]s. While Xizor managed to escape, Imperial forces landed in the area to capture Pavan. The Jedi eventually escaped when the reactor of the [[Factory District droid plant]] overloaded and detonated, creating an eighty meter crater and leveling the entire district.
